response.rationale: The English cue and sense are correct, and “transfer bank” is ordinary Indonesian. However, “pindahan bank” is not sufficiently established as the safest common Malaysian Malay equivalent; authoritative Malaysian references support “pindahan wang” or “pemindahan wang,” including bank-to-bank transfers. The relation label is therefore overstated, and no false-friend contrast is present.
